product_name_specific: Mazda CX-5 (KE), Mazda 6 (GJ, GL), Mazda 3 (BM, BN)
risk_description: A short circuit may occur in the injector control circuit that could stop the engine and the braking assistance is reduced. Those could increase the risk of injury in the event of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
